title: The Rebound Girl
cn: 第 11 集 · 回弹女孩
novel: Ted and Barney [[discussed|discuss]] a [[life-changing|life-changing]] decision. They were both feeling [[lonely|lonely]] after their recent breakups. Barney [[suggested|suggest]] that they should adopt a baby together. Ted thought it was a [[ridiculous|ridiculous]] idea at first. He laughed and told Barney he was being [[crazy|crazy]]. But Barney was [[serious|serious]] and tried to [[convince|convince]] Ted it was a good plan. He said they could raise the child together and be great fathers. Ted [[considered|consider]] it for a moment but [[ultimately|ultimately]] decided against it. Meanwhile, Robin tried to [[discourage|discourage]] Marshall and Lily from moving to Long Island. She did not want her best friends to move far away. She came up with many reasons why the suburbs were [[terrible|terrible]]. She said the commute would be [[exhausting|exhausting]] and the [[neighborhood|neighborhood]] would be boring. Robin [[argued|argue]] that the city was much more exciting. She pointed out all the great things about living in New York. Marshall and Lily [[listened|listen]] to her concerns but said they needed more space for the baby. Robin felt [[selfish|selfish]] for trying to stop them. She [[realized|realize]] that she was thinking about herself instead of what was best for them. She finally [[admitted|admit]] that she was afraid of losing their friendship. Marshall and Lily [[promised|promise]] that moving would not change anything between them. They said true friends stayed close no matter the [[distance|distance]].

serious.en: not joking; meaning what you say

promise.en: to say you will do something
